PRISONERS OF WAR

Welcome! This brief summary will seek to explain the new gameplay component: [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Prisoners of War[ENDCOLOR].[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_JFD_PRISONERS_WAR] Prisoners of War is a new gameplay mechanic resulting from your combat victories. Successfully defeating an enemy unit now has a chance to leave you with prisoners of war, based on the advancement of your military Technologies. Prisoners of War must be dealt with through one of several actions, each rewarding a different Yield.
